note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` widens across rounds: the datasets-server infers the thin `{factory, generator, round}` shape from `batch-r01.jsonl`, then cannot cast the later shards that add `plant`, `domain`/`seed`, `kind`/`designed`/`stack`, `lane` and `zone` -- the exact struct-cast TypeError the viewer reports. Declaring the union as `json` key-bags fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on 220 of 220 records; always a string, never a list

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys and value types differ per tool -- `command`, `url`, `path`, `args`, `old`/`new`, `cmd`, `diff`, `pattern`, `glob`, `target`, `contents` are strings while `read_file.limit` is an int on 18 steps

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool), `tests_passed` and `cost_steps` (int) on every record, plus `retries` (196), `duration_min` (130), `wasted_calls` (130), `plan_changes` (124), `handoff` (38) and `residual` (9) across 8 observed key shapes

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `seed`/`domain` (196), `kind`/`designed`/`stack` (130), `plant` (84), `lane` (12) and `zone` (6) across 6 observed key shapes

disclosures: All 220 records are `feature-flag-debug-factory` episodes generated by `grok-4.6`, dest-stamped on every record, with `ffd-` ids over rounds 1-110. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.

122 records carry `leftover` in `meta.domain`, spread over 61 rounds that each hold one `leftover` and one `drop` record; 61 of the 122 also carry `leftover` in the record id. These are this factory's own advertised leftover assignment/override mechanic -- targeting rules, audiences, constraints and segments left behind so a percentage rollout or a later SDK evaluates them wrongly -- not a foreign dump.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis` (3698 of 3698). There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
